title: Polynomial oracle characterization of exponential time

replaced:
Let $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$ be the language of strings encoding a machine description
$\alpha$, an input $x$, and a unary time parameter $n$, for which the machine decoded
from $\alpha$ accepts $x$ within $2^n$ steps. Then deterministic polynomial time with
oracle $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$ equals deterministic exponential time:
$\mathrm{P}^{\mathrm{EXPCOM}} = \mathrm{EXP}$.
